title: Who Did It? Not With Passive Se
goal: Leave the doer out with passive se, or name the doer with a ser passive or an active sentence.
grammar: No doer with por after passive se

items: I can leave out who did it when I use passive se.
I can name who did it with a ser passive and por, or with an active sentence.
I can use the new words for buildings, bridges and the people who build them.
